'''Rogue Eleven''' was a [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] used by [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] and [[Snowspeeder/Legends|snowspeeder]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and later [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="Episode V" /><ref name="XW:RS" />

Pilots who have flown under this call sign include:
*[[Tenk Lenso]] ([[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]])<ref name="GG3">[[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back'', Second Edition]]</ref>
*[[Isplourrdacartha Estillo|Plourr Illo]] ([[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]])<ref name="XWRS:MR">[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron 35|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' 35]]</ref>
*[[Lujayne Forge]] ([[6 ABY/Legends|6.5 ABY]])<ref name="XW:RS" />
*[[Asyr Sei'lar]] ([[7 ABY/Legends|7]]&ndash;[[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]])<ref name="XW:SC">''[[X-Wing: Solo Command]]''</ref><ref name="XW:IR">''[[X-Wing: Isard's Revenge]]''</ref>
*[[Dinger]] ([[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]])<ref name="Onslaught">''[[The New Jedi Order: Dark Tide I: Onslaught]]''</ref>
*[[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] (25 ABY)<ref name="Onslaught" />

==Behind the scenes==
The call sign Rogue Eleven was first mentioned in [[Star Wars]]: [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|Episode V The Empire Strikes Back]].
